creator: Alexander Terp
description:
An agent looking for "FAIL" in another pane's history pages through `muster pane read` in 4 MiB pages. vt-1.0.0 adds `ghostty_search_*`: active area and scrollback of both screens, correct through reflow and pruning, byte-exact with ASCII case-insensitive matching, no regex.

A verb such as `muster pane read --find <text>` returning stable row numbers would be about 150 lines across daemon, proto, CLI and API. Run `feed` under the pane's lock and `tick` outside it so output does not stall. Search keeps compressed pages compressed (0d015b2fc), so it suits a_2vgzgocbC. The alternative, formatting plain text under the lock and searching in Rust, gives regex and works at the pin, but stalls output and decompresses history.

Closes the daemon-side search a_29Ayr1P8F asked for.
title: Search a pane's history without paging all of it
